name: seshi
description: Session Capture: uploads Claude Code sessions to your team's seshi server as they happen, with a /seshi skill, and in the desktop app a Session Capture chip and /session-capture, to turn capture off or on for a session.

command.title: seshi command
command.description: The seshi program the Session Capture chip runs: a name on the app's PATH, or a full path when the desktop app does not see your shell's PATH (`which seshi` prints it).
